THE COMPOSITION PARADIGM
Not a component library.
A composition system.

Traditional registries give you hundreds of disconnected buttons and tables, leaving you to manually reconcile spacing, typography, and contrast. Tessellate coordinates everything through a unified mathematical Design DNA.

Component Library Approach
Loose Parts: Isolated primitives with no awareness of the surrounding screen or product domain.
Styling Discordance: Radii clash, hover states conflict, and color chroma drifts across pages.
Manual Assembly: You write boilerplate glue code to stitch components into coherent layouts.
Blind AI Prompts: Code LLMs hallucinate mismatched class names and invent inconsistent CSS tokens.
Outcome: A fragile frankenstein interface that requires constant manual CSS refactoring.
Tessellate Composition Engine
Deterministic ProductModel: Extracts domain archetypes, user sophistication, and core JTBD before generating screens.
Unified Design DNA: All components dynamically inherit and harmonize curvature, contrast, motion, and typography.
100-Point Audit Engine: Evaluates cohesion, accessibility (WCAG AA/AAA), performance, and responsive layout before export.
Validated Mutations: Humans and coding agents modify interfaces through structured, lock-respecting mutations.
Outcome: Zero-debt, fully accessible React + Tailwind 4 production codebase with complete design cohesion.
THE RESOURCE VOCABULARY
Real resources. Zero synthetic filler.

Every component in Tessellate is production-grade React + Tailwind 4, verified against accessibility baselines and exportable without proprietary runtimes.

INTERFACE MATHEMATICS
Compatibility scoring & normalisation.

How does Tessellate prevent components from clashing? Every combination is scored along multi-dimensional Design DNA vectors before rendering.

DNA Distance Vector

Measures Euclidean distance between a component’s inherent aesthetic priors and your project’s target DNA. Discrepancies are flagged or automatically resolved.

Hard Constraint Gates

Non-negotiable rules: WCAG contrast floors cannot drop below AA (or AAA when requested), bundle budgets must stay under performance caps, and prohibited dependencies are rejected.

Responsive Substitution

When a wide desktop data table is viewed on mobile, the engine automatically substitutes a touch-friendly stacked record card without breaking your screen schema.

AGENT-NATIVE ARCHITECTURE
Built for autonomous agents and humans alike.

Coding agents like Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and Copilot struggle when asked to edit arbitrary CSS and complex component hierarchies from scratch. Tessellate gives them a deterministic, schema-validated operating contract.

Machine-Readable Manifests: Everything compiles to validated .tess.json files.
Structured Mutations: Agents modify layouts via typed operations with inverse rollbacks.
Zero Hallucinations: Components use registered semantic slots rather than loose arbitrary HTML.
Complete Handoff Package: Generates AGENT_HANDOFF.md with setup instructions and schema tokens.
